command_or_source: App commit a61093e3fdde8445ce98094398c39f4d2780736b: bash scripts/test.sh with MockMultitouchMonitor, MockTrackpadPermissions, MockTrackpadShortcutPoster and MockAlerts.
result_summary: Injected monitor-start failure and accessibility denial both preserve the requested mapping, return an ineffective result, and emit a specific notification. Clearing the last mapping stops only the trackpad monitor; existing keyboard and mouse services remain independent.
limitations: A real TCC revocation during an active process and a real private-framework removal cannot be injected on the development machine.
